recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, low-angle portrait of a man with a large, rounded afro, characterized by intense golden backlighting that creates a glowing halo effect through the hair texture. The color palette is monochromatic warm sepia and deep browns, with a thin cream-colored border framing the entire composition.
coreVisualRelationships: The glowing halo of the afro against the dark, muted background
The vertical text alignment contrasting with the horizontal tilt of the head
The soft skin textures against the sharp, backlit hair fibers
The thin outer border containing the expansive, tight-cropped subject
coreInvariants: Strong rim lighting on the hair
Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject
Vertical text orientation in the lower right quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's head is centered but tilted, filling approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bridge of the nose serve as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the glowing hair, moves down to the eyes, and follows the tilt of the head to the vertical text in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the upper corners around the hair and the bottom left shoulder area.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast between the dark skin tones and the bright backlit hair.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical orientation with characters rotated 90 degrees clockwise

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the subject's shoulder area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both name and title, separated by a thin vertical line or space.
graphicDevices: Vertical hairline separator between text elements

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, clean, and modern soul aesthetic.
Provides the necessary geometric clarity for vertical reading.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle studio portrait of a man with a large afro. Use warm sepia tones and intense golden rim lighting that makes the hair glow. The background should be a dark, out-of-focus brown. Frame the image with a thin cream-colored border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase sans-serif text in cream color, oriented vertically in the bottom right corner. Use a bold, condensed font. Include a thin vertical line as a separator between the two words.

verificationChecks: Is the hair glowing with golden light?
Is the color palette strictly warm/sepia?
Is the text oriented vertically in the bottom right?
Is there a thin cream border around the entire image?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Exact facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Highly detailed hair fibers in the backlit areas

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the vertical orientation.
Check that the rim light does not blow out the details of the hair entirely.
Verify the cream border is perfectly uniform on all sides.
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle portrait + Afro rim-lighting + Sepia palette + Vertical Sans-Serif + Cream border frame.
